tasks.disposition: Added inspect_pathbank_archive_member and hardened build_pathbank_archive_manifest_entry in src/pathwaymech/pathbank_provenance.py (verified in tests/test_pathbank_identifier_authority.py) to automate closed pathbank-biopax-zip manifest entry construction, unique-member/valid-ZIP/relative-path verification, primary SMP[0-9]+ root pathway verification via pathbank_terms, and external CHEBI/NCBITaxon/UniProtKB UnificationXref enumeration; registered pathbank-primary-2019-PW000977-SMP0000993 in Cycle 3 Stage 1 and pathbank-primary-2019-PW002028-SMP0002042 (curating PathBank:SMP0002042 in data/pathways/thiamin-diphosphate-biosynthesis-escherichia-coli.yaml) in Cycle 4 Stage 1 (add_records); 37 remaining non-duplicate Escherichia coli PathBank primary BioPAX .owl entries in pathbank_primary_biopax.zip remain deferred for per-slice authority verification alongside curated records.

Resolved in Stage 6 by enhancing _serialize_record in src/pathwaymech/curation.py with _detect_yaml_width, _collect_anchored_subtrees, and _restore_yaml_anchors so guarded publication preserves per-file line-wrap widths (80, 88, 100, 120, 4096) and YAML anchor/alias structure (&id001/*id001) across deep copies; verified by unit tests in tests/test_curation_publication.py.

Resolved in Stage 6 by adding optional MechanisticEdge.coefficient, EdgePredicateEnum.encodes, EvidenceItem.assay_taxon, and EvidenceItem.eco_code in src/pathwaymech/schema/pathwaymech.yaml, src/pathwaymech/schema.py, and src/pathwaymech/kgx.py; verified in both open and closed LinkML validators by tests/test_linkml_schema.py and adopted across 6 pathway records in Cycle 2 Stage 2, all 8 remaining PathBank:* records in Cycle 3 Stage 2, and 8 additional MetaCyc/GO records in Cycle 4 Stage 2 (causal_graphs).

Resolved in Stage 6 by adding Entrez, gomodel, NCBIProtein, Reactome, and SGD URI prefix mappings to CURIE_MAP in src/pathwaymech/sssom.py and updating output/sssom/source_mappings.sssom.tsv; verified by tests/test_sssom_export.py, adopted across all 95 S. cerevisiae SGD records in Cycle 2 Stage 3 (477 SGD:S0000* -> UniProtKB:* mappings), extended across 53 additional records in Cycle 3 Stage 3 (174 mappings comprising 135 MetaCyc:*-MONOMER/MONOMER-* -> UniProtKB:*, 31 EcoCyc:*-MONOMER -> UniProtKB:*, and 8 NCBIProtein:* -> UniProtKB:*), and further extended across 50 MetaCyc:* records in Cycle 4 Stage 3 (209 mappings comprising 185 MetaCyc:* -> UniProtKB:*, 23 EcoCyc:* -> UniProtKB:*, and 1 NCBIProtein:* -> UniProtKB:*).

Resolved in Stage 6 by adding BiGG -> biolink:BiochemicalReaction to _PREFIX_CATEGORIES in src/pathwaymech/kgx.py and rejecting mixed explicit/omitted reaction category lists in _validate_named_nodes in src/pathwaymech/schema.py; verified by tests/test_kgx_export.py and tests/test_linkml_schema.py, confirmed across all 271 records in Cycle 2 Stage 4 (record_review), followed in Cycle 2 Stage 5 (resolve_review_findings, #692) by adding explicit molecular_activity reaction categories to all 279 catalytic reactions across the remaining 56 untyped MetaCyc records, confirmed across all 272 records / 1,603 reactions in Cycle 3 Stage 4/5 (#704), and confirmed across all 273 records / 1,613 reactions in Cycle 4 Stage 4/5 (#714).
